verdict_text: YES. The script computes `delta = B @ A` giving `[2304, 768]`, transposes it because `fan_in_fan_out` is true, scales by `lora_alpha / r = 2`, and adds it to the base `[768, 2304]` Conv1D weight in float32, leaving the name, shape and dtype intact. All four required checks run before any writing, and a missing adapter key would raise a KeyError, so failures are loud. The sharder packs tensors in order under 104,857,600 bytes of tensor data, isolates an oversized tensor such as `wte.weight` in its own shard, and writes `model.safetensors.index.json` whose `weight_map` covers every tensor. Unchanged tensors are passed through untouched, so they stay bit-exact.
